desc: Implement full solution: offset=S, target=k+off, guard target∈[0,2S].
Zero-product DP: bitsets over (hasZero, parity) for reachability of sum k with ≥1 zero.
Positive-product DP: product-indexed even/odd sum-bitsets with start and append transitions, skipping products>limit and elements>limit, excluding zeros.
Answer scan: p from limit down to 1 (return first match), else 0 if zeroReach, else -1.
Verified edge cases: all-zeros k=0→0, single element >limit→-1, ones with k=0, unreachable k, |k|>S, empty-subsequence exclusion.
